integrity: The census directly implements the published definitions of trivial petal deletion, crossing exchange, height rotation, and half-turn. Enumeration is over every normalized eleven-petal word. The bundled verifier also checks the source's explicit crossing-exchange example and its three named locally rigid nine-petal representatives.
scientific_limitations: This is an exact finite census of local move applicability for eleven-petal words. It does not classify knot types, does not count hard unknots, and does not prove an asymptotic density. Dihedral local rigidity is a necessary local obstruction, not a complete hardness criterion.
title: Exact eleven-petal local-rigidity census
